title: Figure 26: Monthly Distribution of Balloon-Evaluated vs. All Other Object Sightings
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing the monthly distribution, January through December, of "Total Less Balloon" object sightings (left) with sightings evaluated as "Balloon" (right), both in percent from 0 to 40. July and August have the longest bars. Caption: "FIGURE 26 COMPARISON OF MONTHLY DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS EVALUATED AS BALLOON VERSUS TOTAL OBJECT SIGHTINGS LESS BALLOON"; drawing A-7504.
